d: Instructors at Qatar Technical Institute (QTI) form the backbone of the training ecosystem and play a critical role in delivering high-quality UK Level 3/4 equivalent vocational, technical, defence training and Ministry of Education and Higher Education (MoEHE) approved undergraduate programmes to military students in Qatar.

The primary responsibility of the instructor is to plan, prepare, deliver, assess, and continuously improve learning activities that develop the knowledge, skills, behaviours, and competencies required by the Qatar Armed Forces and other stakeholders. Instructors are expected to create engaging, learner-centred environments that promote academic achievement, practical competence, professional conduct, and operational readiness.
Key attributes of Technical Instructors at QTI include
Deliver high-quality theoretical and practical instruction.
Prepare lesson plans and other training materials, in accordance with approved curricula and awarding body requirements.
Assess student performance and provide timely, constructive feedback.
Maintain accurate student records in accordance with organisational policies and LMS platforms.
Support curriculum development and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure the safe operation and effective utilisation of laboratories, workshops, training equipment, simulators, and instructional resources.
Maintain and enhance professional, technical, instructional, and subject matter expertise through Continuing Professional Development (CPD) activities.
Participate in mandatory training, workshops, standardisation activities, professional and industry engagement opportunities.

Instructors are expected to demonstrate proficiency in the use of modern educational technologies, digital learning platforms, audio-visual systems, interactive training aids and specialist laboratory or workshop equipment relevant to their discipline. They must be capable of integrating technology-enhanced learning approaches to improve student engagement and learning outcomes.

The role requires strong technical expertise, effective communication skills, professional integrity, and a commitment to maintaining high standards of teaching excellence, learner achievement, and military/defence professionalism.
Plan, prepare, and deliver high-quality theoretical, practical, laboratory, workshop, and simulation based training in accordance with approved curricula, schemes of work, and learning outcomes.

Deliver engaging and effective instruction using a range of teaching methodologies, including demonstrations, practical exercises, projects, discussions, problem-based learning, and technology enhanced learning.
Demonstrate and supervise the safe and effective use of specialist equipment, tools, laboratories, workshops, simulators, and training systems.
Differentiate instruction to meet diverse learner needs and support progression towards vocational, technical, defence, and higher education programmes.
Utilise modern instructional technologies, digital learning platforms, and audio-visual training aids to enhance learner engagement and achievement.
Learner Development, Assessment and Quality Assurance

Monitor learner progress and provide timely coaching, mentoring, and constructive feedback to support achievement and professional development. Conduct formative, summative, practical, and competency-based assessments in accordance with approved assessment strategies and quality standards.
Maintain accurate learner records, attendance data, assessment documentation, and progress reports within required timescales.
Contribute to internal quality assurance activities and the continuous improvement of training delivery, assessment practices, and learner outcomes.
Support the development, review, maintenance, and enhancement of courseware, instructional materials, assessments, and learning resources.
Ensure instructional content remains technically accurate, current, and aligned with organisational, military, awarding body, and MoEHE requirements.
Identify and implement opportunities to improve training effectiveness, learner engagement, and programme performance.
Demonstrate exemplary Health, Safety, Environmental, and Security (SHE) behaviours and ensure compliance with all relevant policies, procedures, and safe systems of work.
Promote a safe, disciplined, and professional learning environment within classrooms, laboratories, workshops, and training facilities.
Operate within established organisational communication, reporting, and escalation processes.
Maintain positive and professional relationships with military personnel, learners, and stakeholders.
Operate effectively within a military training environment, adhering to military protocols, standards, and expectations.
Provide instructional support and training cover as required to ensure continuity of programme delivery.
Recognised qualification at UK Level 4 or above in the relevant Engineering, Technical, Vocational, or Professional discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
Demonstrable industrial/defence experience of minimum 5 years and technical competence within the relevant subject area.

Minimum of 2 years’ experience delivering technical, vocational, engineering, defence, or professional training in a structured learning environment. Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications and digital technologies to support training delivery and administration.
Teaching, training, assessing, or instructional qualification or equivalent.
Experience within a military, defence, aerospace, engineering, or other highly regulated environment.
Experience in curriculum development, courseware design, or assessment development.
Knowledge of vocational education, competency-based training, and quality assurance processes.
Experience using Learning Management Systems (LMS), simulation technologies, and digital learning platforms.
Experience of teaching or training in a multicultural environment.
Knowledge of the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) and/or the Defence Systems Approach to Training (DSAT), including related compliance requirements.
Licence, defence certification, relevant professional institution membership, or professional registration.
Evidence of ongoing Continuing Professional Development (CPD).

Secondary: In addition to the primary teaching specialism, instructors are required to support the delivery, development, assessment, verification, and administration of other subject areas, programmes, or training activities within the organisation as directed by the Customer, Line Manager, Head of Department, or Head of the Organisation. Such responsibilities will be allocated based on The Candidate’s qualifications, professional experience, industry background, demonstrated competence, and previous teaching or training experience. Where appropriate, The Candidate may be provided with internal training, mentoring, professional development, or familiarisation activities to enable effective delivery of additional teaching and training responsibilities.

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

q: Prior experience in a similar role, preferably in a hotel or hospitality setting.
Strong command of the English language.
Excellent commitment to service and teamwork.
Attention to detail and the ability to multitask effectively.

r: Regularly check and replenish minibars in guest rooms, ensuring a diverse selection of beverages and snacks.

d: Work as AML, CFT Compliance officer for regular monitoring and reporting of AML, CFT, sanctions and ABC activities for FAB Kuwait.

Assess the effectiveness and efficiency of the controls and processes in FAB Kuwait to ensure compliance with Internal/Group Policies & Procedures and local laws &regulations in particular Kuwait AML, CFT law 106/2013, its explanatory memorandum and any Ministerial resolutions or competent authorities’ decisions in that concerns, Central Bank of Kuwait and CMA regulations, and any subsequent amendments thereof.

To liaise with Country Head of Compliance to ensure that the activities and businesses of FAB Kuwait are carried out in accordance with bank policies and procedures as well as local rules and regulations and to assist Head of compliance Kuwait to manage and mitigate the Regulatory Compliance, Business Conducts CRS, FATCA and other compliance activities associated risks.
q: Bachelor's degree in management, Banking or Finance, preferably with certification in compliance and / or AML.
At least 3 years of banking experience preferably in Compliance / FCC with sound knowledge on regulatory requirements.
Excellent understanding & knowledge of Compliance / FCC local regulatory & International Practices
Good analytical, interpersonal and communication skills.
Fluent in English and Arabic with strong written and verbal skills
Discrete & has integrity Sense & handles highly sensitive information with absolute confidentiality.
r: Ensuring that AML, CFT and sanctions activities and business within FAB Kuwait are managed in compliance with local regulatory requirements via concise, accurate and relevant detecting and reporting mechanism.
Ensure ‘red flags’ for any AML, CFT and sanctions / CDD checks performed have been fully reviewed and that any adverse comments have been fully investigated and the risks are mitigated.
To act as secretary of the Bank Suspicious Transaction Review Committee, calling for the meeting as and when required, ensuring that the committee is functionated in the attainment of its objectives.
Undertake reviews of AML, CFT alerts, suspicious activities, and file Suspicious Activity Reports (SAR’s) to KFIU in line with Bank policies & procedures and as per regulatory requirements.
Act as the point of contact for competent authorities regarding money laundering and terrorist financing issues. Respond promptly to any request for information made by a competent authority.
To provide Support to management and staff in Kuwait on day-to-day activities relating to, Financial Crime including AML, CFT and sanctions related matters that best meet FAB’s interest.
Coordinate with FAB HO AML, CFT and sanctions units for managing FAB Kuwait associated AML, CFT and sanctions related risks.

Prepare and submit periodic management information to Country CEO and Group Compliance on all material cases noted covering at minimum; Number of customer exposure including Customer risk profiles statistics, Number of CDD by compliance and list of declined relationships; Deferrals of KYC requirements; Number of PEP’s identified ‘Number of internal and external STRs filed.
Manage ABC activities within FAB Kuwait and ensure that Business are working in line with relevant policies and procedures. Reporting for any ABC incidents within FAB Kuwait on timely manner.

To Keep abreast of Kuwait AML, CFT law 106/2013, its explanatory memorandum and any Ministerial resolutions or competent authorities’ decisions in that concerns, Central Bank of Kuwait regulations, Kuwait Capital Market Authority regulations and any subsequent amendments thereof.
Maintain a cordial working relationship with other branch Business Lines, Maintain interactive relationships with regulators in Kuwait.

Liaise with Head of compliance in Identifying and managing compliance trainings for core and high-risk areas to ascertain that FAB Kuwait management and staff are aware of their regulatory obligations with emphasis Financial Crime including AML, CFT and sanctions to educate management /staff and raise their awareness of their individual obligations in relation financial crime and have a working knowledge of how to identify suspicious transactions.

Liaise with the Head of compliance in periodic assessment and review of the AML and CFT policies and procedures to ensure that FAB Kuwait has an effective governance framework in place and to execute proper, KYC and due diligence, transactions monitoring activities.
Assist Head of Compliance in fostering continuous improvement in Compliance related Process, systems, and controls.

Liaise with FAB Kuwait Head of Compliance in managing FAB Kuwait compliance functions, FATCA & CRS, and Business conducts functions, ensuring alignment with local regulatory requirements for FAB Kuwait activities & Business Via concise, accurate & relevant compliance monitoring & reporting.
Assist Head of compliance in developing a Risk-Based Compliance Monitoring Program (CMP) with special focus on managing AML, CFT, sanctions and ABC activities monitoring .
To keep abreast of regulatory developments in Kuwait and to review changes to regulation, analyse its impact for FAB.

Conduct reviews as per the monitoring plan and draft compliance reports highlighting regulatory weaknesses and areas of non-compliance for management together with recommendations for corrective action.
Manage periodic monitoring and follow-ups on corrective actions.
Ensure that there is proper coordination with external auditors, local/Group internal auditors to ensure smooth delivery of duties/tasks and that exceptions raised are properly followed-up.
Conduct special investigations or reviews as and when required.

d: To develop and execute marketing initiatives for the bank's products and services, ensuring effective product positioning, customer engagement, and market penetration. q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
3–5 years of experience in marketing, preferably within the banking or financial services sector.
Experience in planning, executing, and monitoring marketing campaigns.
Good understanding of banking products and financial services.
Knowledge of digital marketing channels, social media platforms, and marketing tools.
Experience in market research, competitor analysis, and customer segmentation.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to monitor campaign KPIs and prepare performance reports.
Excellent communication, presentation, and coordination skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
Professional Marketing or Digital Marketing Certification.
Google Analytics or Digital Marketing certifications.
r: Develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns for banking products, including retail and corporate banking products and services.
Promote banking products such as personal finance, credit cards, mortgages, savings accounts, deposits, and other financial solutions.
Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Digital Banking, and Business teams to understand product features, value propositions, and business objectives.
Develop product positioning, key messages, and marketing materials to communicate product benefits and competitive advantages.
Plan and execute product launch campaigns, promotional offers, and customer acquisition initiatives.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify market trends, customer needs, and opportunities for product growth.
Develop targeted marketing campaigns based on customer segments, behaviors, and preferences.
Monitor campaign performance and evaluate effectiveness against KPIs, including customer acquisition, product penetration, conversion rates, and engagement.
Analyze customer insights and market feedback to recommend improvements to product marketing strategies.
Coordinate with creative agencies, media partners, and internal stakeholders to deliver marketing campaigns.
Ensure all product marketing communications comply with the bank's brand guidelines, internal policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Prepare marketing reports, campaign performance analysis, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
